memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine: preventive propranolol 40 mg OD, acute sumatriptan 50 mg SOS, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS; status: 4 headache days/month, mild disability; plan: continue prophylaxis, monitor side effects.
Depression: sertraline 50 mg OD, escitalopram 10 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS; status: PHQ-9 8, improved sleep; plan: maintain antidepressants, review mood.
Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off); advise reduced carbs, walk 30 min daily.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.text: I’ve been feeling dizzy after taking topiramate at night, and my appetite has increased leading to weight gain.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine: dizziness likely topiramate-related; status 3 headache days/month; plan: stop topiramate, start amitriptyline 10 mg HS for migraine prophylaxis and neuropathic pain.
Depression: appetite increase, weight 80 kg, waist 94 cm; PHQ-9 7; plan: continue antidepressants, add lifestyle counselling.
